document: BC Election: As voters begin to lock in, Conservatives hold five-point lead over gaining NDP (Angus Reid Institute, 2026-10-05)
note: Online, Angus Reid Forum, n=1,013. Shares among decided and leaning voters from the release PDF chart 'B.C. provincial vote intent by region' (2026.10.05_BC_Elxn_2.pdf, p. 4); the published tables do not include the vote question. n = decided-and-leaning bases printed on the chart. The 'Other party' segment is not labelled for the regions (residual about 1-2 points), so AUTRES is omitted for regions; national Other 2% from the trend chart (p. 3). Region labels verbatim; 'Fraser Valley' is ARI's Lower Mainland outside Metro Vancouver; 'Island/ North Coast' combines Vancouver Island and the North Coast (new code VANCOUVER-ISLAND-NORTH-COAST).
